artifact_role: Additive source provenance and observed input-domain facts. Existing task, readiness and selected-endpoint contracts remain authoritative and unchanged.

s1_object.container: One validated gzip member containing a tar archive.

selected_member.format: MATLAB level 5, little endian, version word 256

authenticated_release.scope: Identity and observed schema/domain refer to this exact publisher release and selected member. They do not establish the historical source-producing revision or equivalence to the author's driver input.

observed_records.ordering: Recorded struct-field order; no record, neural-row or observation-column reordering.
observed_records.axis_scope: N and T are observed Binary row and column counts. Positions has shape [1,T], Binary [N,T], and ROI [N,1]. These dimensions do not authenticate animal/session identity or experimental alignment.

positions.conclusion: Positions as stored is not an already twelve-class spatial target in any record. The observed finite unique counts range from 399 to 1300.
positions.histogram_scope: All eleven finite cardinalities exceed the declared 64-code histogram envelope. Complete cardinalities and aggregate domain checks were recorded, but full observed-value histograms were explicitly omitted; no input was capped or silently truncated.
positions.encoding_hypotheses: The unchanged values fail the finite-integral prerequisite for both diagnostic 0..11 and 1..12 encodings. Neither encoding was selected or applied.
positions.preprocessing_limit: The original location and algorithm of spatial binning remain unverified, including any transformation in svm_wrapper or a prior processing pipeline. No rounding, casting, rebinning or alias is justified by these observations.
positions.mi_scope: The greater-than-1000 flag concerns distinct finite values in the full-record truth input, not observation count T. It is only a potential label-binning fallback risk; original held-out subsets, predicted labels and the historical dependency execution were not audited. No MI binning was applied.

binary.conclusion: The stored Binary arrays have the observed two-value domain {0,1}. This does not establish the original calcium discretization, semantic alias to R_neuron_binned, or source-record-to-animal mapping.

observed_records.access_scope: The admitted parser materialized source arrays, potentially including ROI arrays. Numeric reductions used Positions and Binary only. No source array was transformed or exported, and ROI contents were not numerically inspected.

source_study_table_check.observed_role: S1 Table is a qualitative outline of the study, not an animal/session manifest.
source_study_table_check.content_summary: The five body rows summarize study questions with their approaches, results, controls and figure references. Full table wording is not reproduced here.
source_study_table_check.conclusion: This selected table does not supply the join from the eleven Sub records to seven animals and original sessions. This is not a claim that such a mapping is absent from every author source.
source_study_table_check.notes_and_footer: Retained notes contain separator/continuationSeparator nodes without visible w:t text. The footer's PAGE field has cached text 2; document layout was not rendered.
source_study_table_check.representation_scope: The compact encoding is lossless relative to the established inspector report, including its ordered tree representation. It does not claim byte-exact XML, all OPC contents or rendered layout. Styles and numbering members are listed in the inventory, but their trees are outside the five retained parts.

superseded_failure.disposition: Preserved bounded representation failure, superseded by a separately admitted successful compact-report operation. The failure did not establish an unsupported format or absence of a cohort mapping.

original_endpoint_constraints.endpoint: Original Figure 2C CA1 population spatial decoding, with linear/RBF and real/conditionally shuffled conditions and held-out confusion-matrix information in bits.
original_endpoint_constraints.spatial_bin_description_conflict: The Figure 2 caption describes twelve equi-distant spatial bins; appendix SM7.2 describes twelve equi-populated bins. The conflict remains unresolved. Observing twelve balanced bins would not prove either generating algorithm.
original_endpoint_constraints.neural_preprocessing_limit: The source description of two calcium bins is not authenticated merely by observing uint8 values {0,1}.
original_endpoint_constraints.population_cap_scope: The retained driver caps local pair-response copies at four; its population SVM calls receive the uncapped R. That pair-specific cap does not authorize population preprocessing.
original_endpoint_constraints.folds: The paper/appendix specifies five outer folds and two inner optimization folds. The retained driver sets two outer and two inner folds. No replacement or shared folds are invented.
original_endpoint_constraints.shuffled_fields: The retained driver assigns the shuffled linear-derived vector to the RBF field and the shuffled RBF-derived vector to the linear field. Source labels require explicit reconciliation.
original_endpoint_constraints.shuffles: Conditional population shuffling and the MI estimator's thirty bias-subtraction permutations are distinct procedures; neither is performed or conflated here.
original_endpoint_constraints.reference_object: The driver saves CA1_Fig2.mat, while the pinned plotter loads CA1_Figure2.mat. Exact original reference vectors and their record/kernel/condition/shuffle/fold axis order remain unverified.
original_endpoint_constraints.reduction_scope: Source-supported 55 real, 110 shuffled and paired 55 shuffle-averaged reductions remain distinct. Computed-but-unused plotter mean/SEM variables do not establish the published SEM.

required_source_binding.preprocessing: Recover the original Hippocampus_data input and its source-backed preprocessing route with Position/R_neuron_binned identities, or the source-producing transform, spatial-bin edges/algorithm and encoding that bind this exact release to that input. A structural rename alone is insufficient.
required_source_binding.cohort: Recover an authoritative join from all eleven recorded labels to the original sessions/FOVs and seven animals, with source row/column identity.
required_source_binding.implementation: Recover the source-producing revision and exact svm_wrapper, conditional shuffle and MI-related implementations, dependency versions and relevant defaults. These remain unverified in the bounded retained scope; global absence is not asserted.
required_source_binding.partitions: Recover the original per-record/kernel/condition/shuffle outer and inner partition indices and their index base/order, resolving the five/two versus two/two discrepancy without inventing common folds.
required_source_binding.references: Authenticate CA1_Figure2.mat or the exact source-linked equivalent reference object, keyed vectors and axis/order metadata, and reconcile the shuffled-field assignment.

claim_boundaries.historical_equivalence: Not established: original preprocessing, cohort mapping, partitions and reference-vector ordering remain unresolved.
claim_boundaries.qualified_author_method_rerun: Distinct from historical equivalence. It requires a separately selected, evidence-backed and frozen protocol with unresolved choices disclosed. No such run is performed or authorized by this provenance artifact.
claim_boundaries.descriptive_finite_record_scoring: Distinct from both original-paper reproduction and a qualified author-method rerun. It cannot replace the selected endpoint or count as an improvement; no such score is introduced here.
